decision_conditions:
<p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom:0cm;line-height:15.0pt"><span style="font-size:10.5pt;font-family:&quot;Segoe UI&quot;,sans-serif;mso-fareast-font-family:
&quot;Times New Roman&quot;;mso-fareast-language:EN-GB">The proposed development, by
reason of its design, siting and form as a self-contained dwelling within the rear
garden, fails to achieve a high standard of design, that&nbsp;</span><span style="font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, sans-serif;">responds positively to local distinctiveness,&nbsp;</span><span style="font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 10.5pt;">representing an uncharacteristic and incongruous form of backland
development that fails to respect the established pattern and layout of
development along Windermere Avenue and the wider area, contrary to Policy D3 of the London Plan 2021 and Policies D12.1, D12.2 and
D12.3 of Merton Local Plan 2024.</span></p>

<p class="MsoNormal">The applicant has failed to demonstrate how vehicles can
safely access and manoeuvre to and from the application site, how vehicles can
be parked without prejudice to other users of the shared rear access, how home
deliveries would be carried out and how the development provides a suitable
access and equipment for firefighting, contrary to Policy T16.3 of Merton’s
Local Plan 2024 and Policy D12 (Fire safety) of the London Plan 2021.<o:p></o:p></p>

<p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom:0cm;line-height:15.0pt"><span style="font-size:10.5pt;font-family:&quot;Segoe UI&quot;,sans-serif;mso-fareast-font-family:
&quot;Times New Roman&quot;;mso-fareast-language:EN-GB">In the absence of sufficient and
satisfactory cycle parking and refuse and recycling storage provision, by
reason of the undersized, impractical and unsecured cycle storage and the
inconvenient and poorly located refuse arrangements, the development has failed
to demonstrate that it would provide secure, accessible and usable cycle
facilities or convenient and effective waste management, resulting in a scheme
that would fail to promote sustainable transport, discourage proper use of
refuse facilities and potentially harm the character and functioning of the
area, contrary to policies T5, SI 7 and SI 8 of the London Plan 2021 and
Policies D12.2 and D12.3 of Merton’s Local Plan 2024.<o:p></o:p></span></p>

<p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom:0cm;line-height:15.0pt"><span style="font-size:10.5pt;font-family:&quot;Segoe UI&quot;,sans-serif;mso-fareast-font-family:
&quot;Times New Roman&quot;;mso-fareast-language:EN-GB">The proposal, by reason of design, access and siting would result in an intensified residential use of the site, resulting in increased activity to and from the site within close proximity of neighbours,&nbsp; including pedestrian movements and servicing (in particular bins) which would give rise to noise and disturbance that is not characteristic of the
surrounding area given the back land siting, to the detriment of the residential amenity of neighbouring
occupiers, in particular Nos. 7 and 11 Windermere Avenue, contrary to Policy D6
of the London Plan 2021 and </span>Merton Local Plan 2024 policies D12.3 and
D12.4<span style="font-size:10.5pt;font-family:&quot;Segoe UI&quot;,sans-serif;
mso-fareast-font-family:&quot;Times New Roman&quot;;mso-fareast-language:EN-GB">.<o:p></o:p></span></p>
description: Proposed Conversion of Outbuilding into Studio Flat with amenity space, cycle storage, refuse bins, parking space and installation of solar plates. .
